title: Layer manifest line
description: One line of <store>/harness/<model dir>/manifest.jsonl (layer.ModelDir: the model id with bytes outside [a-z0-9.-] written as _hh), the append-only record of a model's layer: each definition written, removed, reverted or rolled back, and the passes that change no file. A line without an op is skipped on read. The definitions themselves (<kind>/<name>.rows, held/<kind>/<name>.rows, blobs/<digest>.rows) are text in the rows codec with a layer header table, not JSON. Source: memory/layer/manifest.go (Generation, the Op constants), memory/layer/migrate_v2.go (OpMigrateV2), memory/layer/layer.go (Kind constants, Digest).

gen.description: The generation number, from 1 in manifest order.

digest.description: layer.Digest of the content written: 16 hex characters.

scope.description: A put that settled a held definition: the repositories and task families its evidence covered (rules.Settlement.Scope), where it applies (layer.Harness.InScope).
